race.comment: PARCAE (14) looked very good winning on debut at Mornington, backed as if unbeatable and justifying the $1.45 quote with an easy win on speed. She looks capable of measuring right up and will be very hard to catch once more. SALAMANCA SIX (12) won nicely on debut at Bendigo as a short priced favourite before tackling a much stronger race at G3 level at Flemington. He can bounce back quickly. MYHRO'S RULER (9) was a six-length winner fresh at Echuca but didn't measure up in the G3 Vain Stakes. He can bounce back off a let up. BEL LUPA (13) resumes. She won her maiden well fresh last campaign and is in the mix.
